rejected.reason: Cross-talent synergy with T_DREAM_PRISON is explicitly documented in Dream Prison (mod-tome.lua: 梦境牢笼 — 如梦魇的伤害和睡眠的传染效果，将在此效果持续过程中失效), following the same precedent as 0534 a35e81819f52 (Called Shots / Concealment). Not a defect in EFF_NIGHTMARE.
